bio: Pasajero Studio creates original short films, analog photography, and visual art — not for clients, but as pure creative expression. Every piece is crafted with intention, from grading to final delivery.

At the same time, we're building the next generation of AI-powered tools for filmmakers and colorists. Our first product — intelligent PowerGrade generation for DaVinci Resolve — is currently in development.
